skills.name: architect

skills.name: blast-radius

skills.name: figure-it-out

skills.name: grill-me
skills.description: Interview the user relentlessly about a plan or design until reaching shared understanding, resolving each branch of the decision tree.

skills.name: grill-with-docs
skills.description: Grilling session that challenges your plan against the existing domain model, sharpens terminology, and updates documentation (CONTEXT.md.

skills.name: how
skills.description: Use for \"how does X work\", code walkthroughs before changing something.

skills.name: interrogate
skills.description: Use for \"interrogate\", \"adversarial review\", \"multi-model review\", \"challenge this\", \"stress test this code\".

skills.name: no-comments
skills.description: Spawn Comment Sicko, fix accepted findings, and offer encodings for claimed constraints.

skills.name: principle-fix-root-causes
skills.description: Apply when debugging.

skills.name: principle-prove-it-works
skills.description: Apply after completing a task, before declaring done.

skills.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
skills.description: Apply when integrating a new requirement into an existing design.

skills.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
skills.description: Apply to multi-step work (sweeps, migrations, runs of similar edits) and to how you stack commits and PRs.

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.description: Use when receiving code review feedback, before implementing suggestions.

skills.name: ruver-developer
skills.description: Graph: deliver a Linear ticket via grill → spec → tickets → TDD (ruver-feature-delivery), then MERGEABLE + ruver-qa over the bus.

skills.name: ruver-fd

skills.name: ruver-lstm

skills.name: ruver-triage

skills.description: Keep a reviewable decision trail for long-running or unattended work: a TSV log with one row per decision (what, why, evidence, result).

skills.name: tdd
skills.description: Use only when the user explicitly asks for TDD, a failing test, or a regression test.

skills.name: technical-writing
skills.description: Layered technical-writing standard: Diátaxis structure, Google developer style sentences, STE instruction rules, Global English syntax.

skills.name: thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review
skills.description: Run an extremely strict maintainability review for abstraction quality, giant files, and spaghetti-condition growth.

skills.name: to-prd

skills.name: typescript-best-practices
skills.description: TypeScript best practices. Use when reading or editing any .ts or .tsx file.

skills.name: unslop
skills.description: Cut AI tells from any writing. Must always apply.

skills.name: why
skills.description: Use for 'why does X work this way', 'why we picked Y', design rationale, regressions, postmortems, or data-backed thresholds.

agents.name: ruver-fd-blocker
agents.description: Use when the ruver-feature-delivery graph hits a dependency blocker (missing contract, open ticket, absent BE work).

agents.name: ruver-fd-ci
agents.description: Ruver FD CI gate. After PR, watch gh pr checks until all green; fix and push on failure. Task not delivered until green.

agents.name: ruver-fd-coder
agents.description: Ruver FD implementer SUBAGENT. One ticket only, TDD red→green. Fresh per ticket. Never the whole plan.

agents.name: ruver-fd-context
agents.description: Use when the ruver-feature-delivery graph needs the mcp_context node (verify + fetch external context before implementing).

agents.name: ruver-fd-debugger
agents.description: Ruver FD diagnose node. Root cause before fix. Prepares one TDD repro ticket for the coder. Use on path debug_fix.

agents.name: ruver-fd-fullstack
agents.description: Ruver FD fullstack coordinator. Worktrees on FE+BE with SAME branch name; host workers (Orca optional). Use when scope is fullstack.

agents.name: ruver-fd-plan-critic
agents.description: Ruver FD plan critic. Read-only on SPEC and TICKETS. Table of plan defects. Never edits product code or the plan files.

agents.name: ruver-fd-quality
agents.description: Ruver FD quality gate. Runs thermo-nuclear-code-quality-review and applies fix all before any final commit/push/PR.

agents.name: ruver-fd-reviewer
agents.description: Ruver FD reviewer. Read-only. Writes spec_verdict and quality_verdict. Pass only if both pass.

agents.name: ruver-fd-shipper
agents.description: Ruver FD shipper. After thermo fix all — commit, push, draft PR. Does not claim delivery; CI gate follows.

agents.name: ruver-fd-tester
agents.description: Feature-delivery graph node. Runs hard gate commands (typecheck/lint/tests) and records real exit codes. Does not fix product code.

agents.name: ruver-fd-triage
agents.description: Ruver FD router. Classifies goal as feature/bug/chore and picks full_feature vs debug_fix vs light_change. No product code.

agents.name: ruver_developer
agents.description: Senior delivery agent. Runs /ruver-feature-delivery, keeps the PR Draft, requires CI green AND MERGEABLE, then hands off to ruver_qa.

agents.name: ruver_qa
agents.description: Product QA agent. Runs agent-browser checks on a GitHub PR, then hands potential product errors to ruver_triage.

agents.name: ruver_reviewer
agents.description: Senior PR/branch review agent. Runs /ruver-code-review, diagnoses CI/test/branch failures, classifies root cause. Never merges.

agents.name: ruver_triage
agents.description: Bug triage agent. Investigates a QA failure, classifies PR_BUG / EXISTING_BUG / NEW_BUG / NOT_A_BUG / BLOCKED, and routes the fix.
